how_to_apply: The application process is entirely offline. The notification does not provide any online application portal.
Download the application form from the official website: mahabubnagar.telangana.gov.in under "District Notifications".
Fill in the application form (Notification No. 1994/E1&E3/DM&HO/MBNR/2026, dated 19.09.2026) with accurate personal, educational and council registration details.
Paste a recent photograph on the form and sign across it.
Attach self-attested copies of all required certificates listed above.
Enclose the application fee as a Demand Draft in favour of the Administrative Officer, O/o DM&HO, MBNR.
Submit the filled application in person at: O/o DM&HO, Mahabubnagar District, Room No. 201, IDOC Building, Boothpur Road, Mahabubnagar District.
Applications will be received from 22.09.2026 to 26.09.2026, up to 5:00 PM.
important_instructions: Candidates should submit the University-approved conversion formula/method for converting Grade Points/CGPA into equivalent marks/percentage, wherever applicable, to facilitate merit list preparation. The Rule of Reservation applicable to local and non-local candidates will follow the Presidential Order. A roster will be followed for posts with more than one vacancy; the existing roster will be continued. Selected candidates' postings will be issued as per merit, roster and options after completion of the selection process. Vacancies may be terminated earlier than one year if regular candidates report for duty, or on grounds of poor performance, at the discretion of the District Collector and Chairman of the District Health Society.

content_sections.heading: NHM Mahabubnagar Vacancy Details 2026 - Post-wise Break-up
content_sections.text: A total of 38 posts are to be filled across various NHM programmes such as Child Health, Comprehensive Primary Health Care, National Programme for Palliative Care, NCD Control, Healthcare of the Elderly, National Urban Health Mission, RBSK and Telangana Diagnostics. Total: 38 posts

content_sections.heading: NHM Mahabubnagar Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must satisfy both the age limit and educational qualification prescribed for the post they are applying for. Category-wise reservation and the Rule of Reservation (RoR) will be followed as per Presidential Order 2018 and Government Orders in force. Minimum age is 18 years and maximum age is 44 years as per Rule 12(1)(a)(v) of the Telangana State and Subordinate Service Rules, 1996. Age is reckoned as on 01.07.2026. Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date.

rows.educational_qualification: Intermediate + DMLT or B.Sc. (LT) from a recognized institution; must be registered with the Para Medical Board

MBBS registered with TG Medical Council (first preference), or BAMS registered with Board of Indian Medicine, or B.Sc. Nursing / GNM registered with TG Nursing Council (candidates graduating before 2020 must have completed the 6-month CPCH bridge programme)
MBBS with a postgraduate degree such as MD (General Medicine) or an equivalent qualification recognized by the NMC/MCI, registered with TG Medical Council
GNM or B.Sc. (Nursing), registered with TG Nursing Council
Bachelor's Degree in Physiotherapy from a recognized university, registered with TG Para Medical Board

MDRA (approved by RCI) with a basic qualification in BPT/BOT/B.Sc. Nursing, OR a PG degree/diploma in Hospital or Health Management/MPH with 1 year's experience (for diploma holders), OR an MBA with 2 years' hospital/health programme experience, OR a Master's in Public Health
MBBS with MD (Paediatrics), or Diploma in Child Health (DCH) if MD is not available; registered with TG Medical Council
SSC + Diploma in Pharmacy, registered with the Pharmacy Council
Certificate of Radiology Assistant (CRA), or a recognized Diploma/Degree in Radiography, registered with the Telangana Paramedical Board

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NHM Mahabubnagar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 38 contract vacancies across posts such as Staff Nurse, MLHP, Lab Technician, Pharmacist, Physiotherapist, Pediatrician, Physician and DEIC Manager.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for NHM Mahabubnagar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application is 26.09.2026, up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. Is the NHM Mahabubnagar Recruitment 2026 application online or offline?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates must download the form, fill it manually, and submit it in person at the O/o DM&HO, Mahabubnagar office.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for NHM Mahabubnagar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum is 44 years, reckoned as on 01.07.2026, with relaxations available for SC/ST/BC/EWS, PH, Ex-Servicemen and NCC categories.

faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 300/- for General candidates and Rs. 200/- for SC/ST candidates, payable via Demand Draft.

faq.answer: Selection is merit-based: 90 marks are awarded for qualifying examination performance and 10 marks for age weightage. There is no written exam or interview mentioned in the notification.
